table_rows.author: Holgado et al. (2026) [Local]
table_rows.methodology: Descriptive-developmental design; hardware prototyping with walk-through trial sessions and faculty evaluation.
table_rows.sample_size: Senior High School Department; trial scan batches and faculty evaluators.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: 93.3% RFID walk-through detection accuracy; 100% backend data logging accuracy; faculty evaluation rated 'Strongly Agree' across usability and reliability.

table_rows.author: Navarra & Antonio (2025) [Local]
table_rows.methodology: Agile Software Development Lifecycle (7 sprints) combined with Descriptive-Evaluative Survey.
table_rows.sample_size: N = 85 respondents (teachers, parents, and secondary school students) at Isulan National High School.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: Overall system evaluation grand mean of 4.72 +/- 0.43 ('Very Functional / Highly Effective'); 95% stakeholder confirmation of process optimization.

table_rows.author: Mahinay & Encarnacion (2024) [Local]
table_rows.methodology: Descriptive-Developmental and evaluative design integrated with Apriori association-rule data mining.
table_rows.sample_size: N = 83 respondents (n = 75 students, n = 8 faculty members) at Saint Michael College of Caraga.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: Overall weighted mean perception score of 4.16 ('Agree'); calculation effectiveness rated 4.24; feedback mechanisms rated 4.12.

table_rows.author: Contreras & Mercado (2024) [Local]
table_rows.methodology: Quantitative pre-experimental repeated-measures design; paired-samples t-test across 4 academic quarters.
table_rows.sample_size: Secondary Science Teachers at Antonio A. Maceda Integrated School, Division of City Schools, Manila.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: Competency scores rose from Q1 baseline M = 78.10 (SD = 9.30) to Q3 M = 89.50 (SD = 9.10); paired t-test t = 4.45 > t_crit = 2.26 (p < 0.05); Q4 maintained M = 86.40.

table_rows.author: Canlas & Ado (2024) [Local]
table_rows.methodology: SDLC Waterfall methodology; ISO/IEC 25010 software quality evaluation; paired-samples t-test.
table_rows.sample_size: N = 120 respondents (faculty, academic administrators, program chairs, students) at PUP Manila.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: Grand mean of 4.56 ('Highly Acceptable') on ISO/IEC 25010; Security at 4.70, Functional Suitability at 4.53, Usability at 4.45; statistically significant latency reduction (p < 0.001).

table_rows.author: Irhamna, Kasmini, & Khairuman (2026) [Foreign]
table_rows.methodology: Research and Development (R&D) prototyping; Aiken's V expert content validation; empirical hardware latency testing.
table_rows.sample_size: Technical expert evaluators and N = 35 university student participants at Universitas Bina Bangsa Getsempena, Indonesia.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: Average RFID read-to-log latency of 0.10 seconds; Aiken's V validity index of 0.982 ('Very Valid'); 100% data transmission reliability under local buffering.

table_rows.author: Jantan, Mohd Zainudin, & Mustafa@Dain (2023) [Foreign]
table_rows.methodology: Iterative-incremental Agile development methodology; descriptive cross-sectional survey.
table_rows.sample_size: N = 140 respondents (lecturers and university students) at Universiti Poly-Tech Malaysia.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: 87.9% of respondents strongly agreed that automated mobile attendance apps streamlined schedule tracking, attendance verification, and absenteeism detection.

table_rows.author: Jones (2022) [Foreign]
table_rows.methodology: Quantitative empirical correlation study; time-series digital learning analytics via VLE telemetry.
table_rows.sample_size: N = 31 undergraduate students enrolled in a digital learning cohort.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: Superficial click counts failed to predict performance (r = 0.12, p > 0.05), while objective completion metrics strongly correlated with final grades (r = 0.58, p < 0.01).

table_rows.author: Edraga (2026) [Foreign]
table_rows.methodology: Controlled experimental design; randomized two-group comparison; expert rubric evaluation across 4 pedagogical criteria.
table_rows.sample_size: N = 16 secondary pre-service teachers (n = 8 AI-assisted experimental, n = 8 manual control) at Northwest Samar State University.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: AI-assisted group achieved significantly higher scores in structural organization (M = 4.63 vs. 3.75) and content depth (M = 4.50 vs. 3.63); manual group scored higher in creativity (M = 4.38).

table_rows.author: Januhari, Setyanto, & Kusrini (2025) [Foreign]
table_rows.methodology: Quantitative empirical design; ISO/IEC 25010 Quality-in-Use model; Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM).
table_rows.sample_size: N = 384 higher education students across diverse academic disciplines in Bali, Indonesia.
table_rows.quantitative_findings: Platform efficiency directly predicted user satisfaction (beta = 0.482, p < 0.001), accounting for 64.2% of satisfaction variance (R^2 = 0.642).
